verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents official SDKs across many platforms. The API reference explicitly names "our official SDKs", rollbar.js is a first-party GitHub SDK for server and client JavaScript frameworks, and the .NET SDK has documented versioning with LTS tracks, offline payload stores and internal-event monitoring. Ruby gem, Apple AUL and Magento modules are also documented, plus in-product warnings when your SDK is out of date. Missing for 10: evidence of official SDKs that wrap the read/management REST API (the documented SDKs are error-reporting notifiers), and independent hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
